t: ff.85 Eating carbonara in the metaverse
st: Apple Vision Pro's iPhone moment and the problem of digital carbonara

sec.p: In the last futuro fortissimo we talked about the screens shown at CES (🎼 ff.84 CES: the tech craft fair). And how, in my view, they were already outdated.
Back to the future. Integrating 3D objects is getting easier and easier thanks to AI. For example, Ammaar used a text-to-3D-object AI to recreate the DeLorean and parked it in his living room.

sec.t: ff.85.3 New life for our past
sec.p: Back to the past. AI and VR are also converging to recreate and “augment” the past.
Finally, it's not futuro fortissimo without a little crypto sprinkled like grana over your carbonara.
